issues.issue: Is the new 2013 Minustah document admissible under s. 110(4) IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant filed a 2013 Minustah report on police responses to rape in Haiti as new evidence; no s. 110(4) submissions shown.
issues.result_quote: I am of the opinion that this document is not admissible in evidence before the RAD.

issues.issue: Should the RAD hold a hearing under s. 110(6) IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: A hearing should be held so the RAD can find her credible.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that no hearing can be held in this appeal.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility assessment of the appellant?
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in its credibility assessment; its negative inferences from her testimony are unreasonable.
issues.result_quote: it is not necessary for the RAD to intervene in this case.
